---
title: "Daybreak statistical report"
output: html_document
params:
  result: null
  narrative: null
  accessible: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
result <- params$result
narrative <- params$narrative
accessible <- params$accessible
```

# `r narrative$title`

```{r everyday, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(accessible)) {
  cat("\n## Everyday explanation\n\n", accessible$question,
      "\n\n### The short answer\n\n", accessible$bottom_line,
      "\n\n### How to picture it\n\n", accessible$picture,
      "\n\n### How sure can we be?\n\n", accessible$certainty,
      "\n\n### What this does not tell us\n\n", accessible$boundary,
      "\n\n", accessible$data_note, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Statistical description

`r narrative$headline`

```{r narrative, results='asis'}
for (card in narrative$cards) {
  cat("\n## ", card$title, "\n\n", card$body, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Estimates

```{r estimates}
if (!is.null(result$estimates)) knitr::kable(plain_table(result$estimates), caption = "Estimates")
```

## Tests

```{r tests}
if (!is.null(result$tests)) knitr::kable(plain_table(result$tests), caption = "Hypothesis tests")
```

## Model fit

```{r fit}
if (!is.null(result$fit)) knitr::kable(plain_table(result$fit), caption = "Model fit")
```

## Checks

```{r checks}
if (!is.null(result$checks)) knitr::kable(result$checks[, setdiff(names(result$checks), "Status"), drop = FALSE], caption = "Checks and limits")
```

## Reproducibility note

All statistics and sentences in this report were produced from deterministic R code. No language model generated or changed a number.

Generated by Daybreak `r DAYBREAK_VERSION` on `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")`.
